newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spot Prods - Gulf gasoline firms, Midco drops.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spot Prods - Gulf gasoline firms, Midco drops.

text.p: U.S. Gulf gasoline differentials firmed a tad after the close on talk of reduced imports in September but activity -- as in the other hubs -- remained quiet late Tuesday, players said.
Midcontinent gasoline, meanwhile, got hammered as sellers tried to unload barrels and make a profit before the end of the summer driving season.
On the NYMEX, September gasoline closed up 2.14 cents at 67.58 cents a gallon and heating oil ended up 0.62 cent at 55.71 cents a gallon. September crude was up 21 cents at $20.12 a barrel.
U.S. GULF COAST
U.S. Gulf unleaded gasoline differentials moved up a tad after the close on Tuesday following talk that problems at Venezuela's Cardon refinery could extend a force majeure into September.
"A force majeure could tighten things up," said a Gulf trader. Venezuela declared a force majeure on nine cargoes in August due to a still unresolved catalytic regenerator problem in the reformer.
Bids for prompt barrels of M1 conventional unleaded gasoline firmed about 0.20 cent to -1.90 cents below the screen. Offers were pegged at about -1.75 cents.
Deals for the prompt, now the back 24th cycle, were done earlier this afternoon at -2.00 cents below the print, said traders.

Regular reformulated gasoline differentials also firmed slightly to 4.00/4.25 cents over the screen in quiet activity. Prompt premium unleaded, which had a scheduling deadline today, eased about a half cent to 5.25/5.50 cents after longs tried to sell off their supply.
In general, players said activity was light, with little refiner interest seen in the market.
MIDCONTINENT
Unleaded gasoline differentials got hammered Tuesday by sellers trying to unload supply to capture values amid strong backwardation on the NYMEX futures and good supply in the region.

Other traders said the selloff could be due to the upcoming switch from the lower summer reid vapor pressure to the higher autumn volume. Suppliers must have a greater RVP in their gasoline by Sept. 15.
In Group Three, unleaaded gasoline fell more than 1.50 cents to -0.50 cents below to even with the print, with deals done at -0.50 cents under.
Any months took a similar slide to 0.25/0.50 cents over the print.
NEW YORK HARBOR
The standoff in New York Harbor gasoline markets continued on Tuesday afternoon, with offers hanging in at firm levels and bidders still hoping to wait for the firmness to go away rather scarce.

"Everyone is on pins and needles waiting to see if someone at Bayway blinks," said one trader, referring resumption of selling by Tosco in connection with the suspected restart of its catalytic cracker at Bayway following unplanned work.
"Even though they're not the biggest player, their absence (as a seller) has caused a lot of focus," the trader said.
Prompt "A2" regular reformulated remained offered at 9.00 cents over September NYMEX, with any month barrels considered doable at 6.00 cents over.
Prompt "M2" regular conventional gasoline was offered at 6.00 cents over and any August was talked at 3.00 cents over. -- New York Energy Desk 1212 859-1620 --
